name: server-mate
description: Lightweight, centralized server monitoring and AI operations workflow for Linux hosts running Nginx or Apache, with optional BT-Panel API integration for agentless remote log collection
author: tankeito
features: Centralized remote monitoring via BT-Panel (Baota) API — collect logs from many hosts with a single Agent, no remote installation required
Byte-offset incremental log fetching with a 5 MB per-cycle chunk cap, protecting against OOM and network timeout when remote error logs explode
Production-grade security guardrails: shlex-based shell-injection defense, NTP time-drift detection on BT signature failures
Multi-site matrix configuration with isolated per-domain rollups
Real-time host metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network)
Extended Linux system metrics — Layer 1: CPU iowait/user/system, memory available, swap, disk IOPS deltas, network Mbps + error/drop counters
Extended Linux system metrics — Layer 2: process count, zombie detection, top-5 CPU and memory processes
Extended Linux system metrics — Layer 3: root inode usage, configurable extra partition monitoring
Extended Linux system metrics — Layer 4: TCP connection state breakdown (ESTABLISHED/TIME_WAIT/CLOSE_WAIT), systemd service health probes
10 new alert kinds: iowait_high, swap_high, memory_critical, net_errors, high_iops, zombie_process, inode_low, disk_multi_low, tcp_timewait_high, service_down
Nginx/Apache access and error log parsing
Traffic analysis (PV, UV, IP, QPS, bandwidth)
Spider detection and traffic separation
Threshold-based webhook alerts
SSH brute-force monitoring with linked guarded auto-ban
Telegram bot alert delivery
AI alert diagnosis with plain-language remediation hints
AI-powered error diagnosis
Daily/Weekly/Monthly PDF reports
GeoIP auto-provisioning via local MaxMind GeoIP.conf, with an operator-reviewed public mirror bootstrap fallback
SSL certificate expiry inspection in reports and webhook summaries
PDF-safe long URL and referer truncation
Guarded auto-ban and auto-heal automation
integrations: BT-Panel (Baota) HTTP API for remote log collection

notes: OPENAI_API_KEY is strictly an optional environment variable, only needed if the user manually enables AI analysis.
Telegram bot_token and chat_id may be stored in config.yaml or supplied via environment variables.
Webhook URLs and tokens are operator-supplied secrets stored in config.yaml.
GeoIP.conf stores MaxMind AccountID and LicenseKey and should stay local-only.
BT-Panel api_key grants full panel privileges. Always inject it via remote_panels.<id>.api_key_env, never commit a config.yaml that contains the plaintext key.

security.default_mode: read-only collection with Guarded Automation dry_run enabled
privileged_operations: Firewall ban and unban commands when auto_ban is enabled
Service restart commands when auto_heal is enabled
operator_review_required: Keep automation.dry_run=true during initial deployment and only disable it after reviewing audit notifications
Only enable auto_ban or auto_heal after reviewing whitelist, cooldown, TTL, and command_template settings
Prefer local MaxMind GeoIP.conf and geoipupdate; review the public mirror fallback before allowing that network path
data_egress: Telegram bot API when Telegram delivery is enabled
OpenAI API when AI analysis is enabled
raw.githubusercontent.com only when GeoIP auto-bootstrap fallback is triggered
User-configured BT-Panel HTTPS endpoints when remote_panels are enabled
